archive_disposition: D-001 accepts the delivered product with two explicitly disclosed evidence boundaries. D-002 treats the implemented login/session behavior and Deepgram Flux speed range as verified facts, not risks.

known_issues.summary: Post-merge strict validation found a placeholder Purpose and Chinese-only normative keywords in the three affected main specs.
known_issues.impact: Runtime behavior is unaffected, but the merged bot-config, call-history, and voice-pipeline specs do not independently pass the current strict linter.
known_issues.next_action: Clarify the affected Purpose text and add RFC 2119 MUST keywords without changing behavior, then validate the three specs strictly.
known_issues.resolution: Updated only the merged Purpose and normative wording in bot-config, call-history, and voice-pipeline; all three affected main specs now pass strict validation.

known_issues.summary: The voice-bot Playwright suite does not load its declared deterministic fixture and reproduces only 2/14 passing tests against an empty Bot database.
known_issues.impact: Checkpoint A/C fixture evidence is not independently reproducible, so the Change cannot be archived on the historical 14/14 claim.
known_issues.next_action: Wire the existing non-secret fixture into the production route/data adapter used by the UI suite, rerun desktop/narrow tests, and request independent re-review.
known_issues.resolution: The suite now reads tests/ui/fixtures/voice-bot-editor.json and intercepts only Bot/history data while exercising the production route/components/DOM. Both desktop and narrow Chromium passed 14/14 against an empty isolated database.

known_issues.summary: docs/engineering/english-flux-voice-agent.md still describes the public product entry as Basic Auth after D-002 established the product login page and Cookie session as current behavior.
known_issues.impact: The reusable engineering documentation contradicts the accepted runtime and the main-spec merge target.
known_issues.next_action: Update only the stale authentication description to the accepted Cookie-session behavior and verify no contradictory current documentation remains.
known_issues.resolution: The engineering guide now describes the product login page and secure Cookie session while retaining the legacy environment-variable names as implementation detail.

unverified_items.summary: Live-microphone WebCall acoustic barge-in lacks retained external-real evidence because the verification host had no microphone.
unverified_items.reason: The implementation and non-acoustic paths were tested; D-001 accepts this as a historical evidence boundary rather than a known product defect.

unverified_items.summary: The approved prototype was not preserved as immutable screenshot files with checksums and generated pixel-diff ratios.
unverified_items.reason: Functional checks and actual screenshots exist, but a baseline cannot be recreated retroactively and called immutable. D-001 accepts this historical evidence boundary.
